semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in silicon components and custom parts essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Shanghai Shengyongcheng Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd. is a key player in the semiconductor industry, focusing on the production of silicon components and custom hardware for various semiconductor processes. With a commitment to innovation and domestic production, the company serves major semiconductor and solar cell manufacturers in China.
capabilities: Silicon boats and rings for PVD and CVD processes
Silicon electrodes and ejector tubes for CMP and ETCH processes
Metal and engineering plastic components like clamp rings and cover rings

regional_presence.China: The company is located in the Lingang New Area of Shanghai and serves numerous domestic semiconductor manufacturers.
